transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what finally scared me into coming in is that... after I eat too much, I’ve been making myself throw up in the bathroom. I just do it so I won't gain weight. But it’s gotten to the point where it isn’t just a one-time mistake anymore, and I knew I needed to talk to someone about it.
Before you make yourself throw up, do you usually eat an unusually large amount of food?

Yes, I do. Usually, it happens after a bridge night, or when I get off a late shift at the store. I might come home and just... eat a lot. I'll have leftover casserole, some cookies I baked, crackers, and ice cream, all in one sitting. It's much, much more than I’d ever put on a plate in front of anyone else.
When these eating episodes happen, do you feel like you can’t stop eating or control what or how much you’re eating?

Yes. Once I start during those times, it just feels like I’m on automatic. I'll be thinking to myself that I really should stop before my husband notices, but I'm still reaching for one more thing anyway. I just can't seem to stop myself once I get going.
Are you currently at a significantly low body weight for your height?
No, I wouldn't say that. I'm pretty average for my height, I think. I haven't lost a significant amount of weight or anything like that. I just... I try to keep it where it is.
How often do these binge-and-vomit episodes happen?

Well, for at least the past several months, it's been happening most weeks. I'll have one of those secret eating spells and then go make myself sick afterward. I can't honestly call it occasional anymore. It's a pretty regular thing now.
